summary: Supervised Linux N71 kernel #5: two simultaneous multitouch IDs at SYN_REPORT boundaries in 273 frames. 2973 EVDEV input records, 391 synchronization frames, 6 tracking starts and 6 releases. After test USB remained reachable, and no new IRQ activity during a 4-second no-touch check. Edge accuracy, latency, sustained operation and boot automation unverified.
